---
title: "After the course"
---
The [companion curriculum](../../companion/index.qmd) covers the material that three days can only mention in passing, in modules that each stand on their own, so take the one you need and leave the rest. Two of the modules below have a section on this case, the module on the items behind the scales and the module on weights. The others teach the same methods on the other cases of the course, and each module says at the top which cases it uses. The section "Going further" at the end of your report holds six more exercises that run in the workspace: a sweep of a whole decision, the five analysts placed on the curve, the checks that the curve leaves out, the multilevel model of the paper fitted to the course data, three ways of computing the standard error, and the two replications with new data.

| If you want | Read |
|---|---|
| The ideas behind what you just did, and the arguments now being made against them | [The multiverse and its critics](../../companion/multiverse.qmd) |
| The graph work at a slower pace: confounders, mediators and colliders, and a graph for a question of your own | [Causal graphs and adjustment sets](../../companion/dags.qmd) |
| Fixed effects, random intercepts, the comparison within and between groups, and inference with few clusters, in more depth | [The statistical methods behind the course](../../companion/stats-methods.qmd), sections 3 to 6 |
| Survey weights: design weights, population weights and post-stratification | [Weights](../../companion/weighting.qmd#sec-trust), the section on this case |
| How the items of a survey scale hang together, and what reliability means for a measure | [The items behind the scales](../../companion/measurement.qmd#sec-trust), section 10 |
| What to do about missing answers, and what listwise deletion costs | [Missing answers](../../companion/missingness.qmd) |
| R from the beginning | [Getting started with R](../../companion/intro-r.qmd) |
| The document format in which your report is written | [Quarto and reproducible documents](../../companion/quarto.qmd) |
| To archive and version the report that you wrote | [Reproducibility repositories](../../companion/repositories.qmd), then [Git and GitHub](../../companion/git-github.qmd) |
| The reproductions and the replications in their own words | The SCORE project of the paper at [osf.io/3ajr9](https://osf.io/3ajr9/), with the reproduction that built the file of the analysts and the replication on rounds 5–9 at [osf.io/e48gd](https://osf.io/e48gd/), and the replication on round 5 at [osf.io/rpumq](https://osf.io/rpumq/) |
| The survey itself | The ESS Data Portal at [ess.sikt.no](https://ess.sikt.no), where the full files of every round can be downloaded after registration |
| The whole story of the case, with the sources | [The case study](../../cases/trust/index.qmd) and the [resources page](../../resources.qmd) |
